title: WICFL site configuration
description: The complete, operator-editable contract for one WICFL microsite. It deliberately contains no component or HTML overrides.

slug.description: Stable lowercase directory and lead-source identifier.

domain.description: Apex production domain, without protocol, path, or www.

brand.description: Public identity shown by the template.

name.description: Approved public business name for this site.

parent.description: Parent organization that owns the microsite.

niche.description: The primary insurance need and intended customer for the site.

audience.description: Primary audience used for information architecture, not a copy template.

geo.description: The real primary market. serviceArea supports eligibility and on-site metadata only; it never creates location pages.

city.description: Primary city represented by the site's original local evidence.

county.description: Florida county for the primary market.

state.description: USPS state code; WICFL is restricted to Florida.

serviceArea.description: Places the agency may serve. The generator must not derive pages, routes, or keyword copy from this list.

locale.description: Language availability. Spanish content is authored in Spanish, never translated from English.

primary.description: Language of the original site content.

alternates.description: Additional independently authored languages available for the same site.

items.description: ISO 639-1 language code supported by the template.

contact.description: Single site-local NAP capture. It is the template source of truth and must be reconciled with the GBP before launch.

trackingPhone.description: Required call-tracking number in E.164 form; rendered and measured by every template contact surface.

displayPhone.description: Human-readable rendering of the tracking phone; its formatting is presentation-only.

address.description: Approved street address for local NAP and disclosures.

street.description: Street address including suite when applicable.

city.description: USPS city for the approved address.

state.description: USPS state code for the address.

licenseNumber.description: Required Florida insurance license number displayed by the template on every required page.

googleBusinessProfilePlaceId.description: Optional GBP Place ID once a profile exists; used by launch QA for NAP reconciliation, not by schema validation.

products.description: Fixed catalog of coverage pages the template may render. Adding a product requires a schema version change and template support.

seo.description: Human-authored page-level SEO inputs for the primary site, not a programmatic location-copy source.

secondaryKeywords.description: Researched supporting phrases, never a city-name substitution list.

analytics.description: Required measurement identifiers. Clearly marked placeholders are valid before accounts are provisioned.

crm.description: Required lead-routing identifiers for the WICFL GoHighLevel sub-account.

formId.description: CRM form identifier or explicit pending placeholder.

leadSource.description: Stable source label used in every submitted lead.

theme.description: Optional, constrained visual variation consumed by shared template tokens. No per-site CSS or component override is permitted.

accentColor.description: Accessible six-digit accent color reviewed against template contrast tokens.

differentiation.description: Required human accountability record of genuine local evidence and non-reusable sections. CI compares rendered content, not these declarations.

localProof.description: Verifiable local facts or sources the author will substantiate in content.

summary.description: Specific evidence to verify before publishing; not reusable boilerplate.

uniqueSections.description: Planned substantive sections that make this site's information architecture non-interchangeable.

title.description: Working title for a site-specific section.

rationale.description: Why the section requires evidence unique to this market and cannot be cloned to another site.

product.description: Coverage product explicitly supported by the shared template.
